reconstruction_notes.en: Original opaque thin mineral drapery with a sloping upper attachment seam, gravity-directed unequal lower growth, broad dominant folds, secondary furls and real graded thickness. NPS Draperies basic growth description consulted. Upper attachment polyline and display root convention recorded; no host ceiling, textile rod, cloth hem or painted single plane. Nominal0.45m height, amber-calcite-like palette and fold layout are art choices, not a specific cave specimen, measured mineral chemistry, ancient shoreline or translucent simulation.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创不透明薄矿物石幔，具倾斜上缘附着缝、重力方向的不等长下缘生长、主褶和次级卷曲及真实渐变厚度。已查NPS Draperies基本生长描述。记录上缘挂点折线及展示原点约定；不混入宿主洞顶、纺织挂杆、布帘缝边或单面贴图。0.45米名义高度、琥珀方解石式配色及褶形布局为美术设定，不是具名洞穴标本、矿物化学测量、古海岸或透光模拟。
